plot: Shoto Todoroki (轟とどろき焦しょう凍と, Todoroki Shōto?), also known as Shoto (ショート, Shōto?), is the main protagonist of the manga and anime series My Hero Academia.

 Background: He is a Grade 1-A student at UA High School, where he was admitted through official recommendations and is training to be a Pro Hero.  He is the youngest son of Endeavor, former #2 and current #1, Pro Hero.

Appearance: Shoto is a moderately tall and rather muscular young man with a well-proportioned body for his age.  He has fairly long hair, although it doesn't go past his neck, and wears bangs, parted on the sides so as not to obscure his view.

Hair: His hair is evenly split into two colors: white on the right and crimson on the left, this unusual color is due to his Quirk.  As another result of this, he also possesses heterochromia iridium, which causes the iris of his left eye to be turquoise blue, while his right is dark gray.

 Eyes: His eyes are, in appearance, rather thin and reserved.  In addition, he has a large burn scar on the left side of his face, extending from his hairline to half of his cheek.  He usually has a serious expression.  However, despite this, some girls in his class have stated that he is handsome and Mina Ashido even goes as far as to say that he is the most handsome guy in Class 1-A.

Outfits: During class, he wears his usual UA men's uniform, replacing his usual brown work boots with casual gray and cyan lace-up sneakers.

Personality: Shoto initially had a cold, aloof personality, rooted in abusive upbringing and complicated family life.  Focused and emotionless, Shoto prefers being alone rather than socializing with others.  However, after the events of the UA Games, Shoto has become more sociable and kind, even with a sense of humor and occasional smiles, despite retaining some of his former aloof demeanor.  mine.  After the Temporary Hero Licensing Course, he began to open up more to his classmates and was softer than his usual serious demeanor.  However, Shoto is still not used to socializing, appearing a bit dense when understanding certain phrases and images of speech.

Detailed Personality: Although usually quiet and reserved, Shoto initially possesses a moderate level of arrogance which, combined with his solitary tendencies, sometimes makes him take the initiative without considering his intentions.  opinions of others, showing confidence that he can overcome any obstacle with his own strength.  He also used to be much less friendly, to the point where his cold demeanor caused a student to resent him.  Even in the present, Shoto seems to prefer acting alone, though only for practical purposes as doing so allows him to unleash his full power without having to worry about his teammates' fire.  Calm and composed, but brutal in combat, Shoto has a solid foundation in the ethics of heroism, wishing only to subdue his frozen opponents rather than kill them by prolonging his freezing time.

Past: Shoto deeply detests his fire ability, which he inherited from Endeavor, as it symbolizes his father's cruelty towards him and his mother and what he was born to be.  into: a tool to overcome All Might, a fate he detests.  As a result, Shoto decided to rely only on his freezing power and never use the other half of his Quirk in battles (only saving for thawing), even covering his left torso and arm.  with ice in his first Hero Outfit.  to symbolize his rebellion against his father.  Shoto is often bothered by Endeavor's mere presence, and can barely contain his anger when talking to him, especially whenever the Pro Hero raises his aim which he had intended for his son before birth.  Ironically, however, Shoto's hatred of his father makes him more like Endeavor, indifferent and indifferent to others while obsessively focused on his goal of rejecting his father.  When he first met him, Inasa noticed that Shoto had the same hateful eyes as Endeavor.

Overall Ability: Trained by his father, Endeavor, as a child, Shoto entered UA High School through recommendations, and has been considered one of the strongest students in Class 1-A.  He earned 2nd place in both the Quirk Comprehension Test and the UA Games.  Shoto also has excellent handling of his versatile and powerful Quirk, the Half-Lold Half-Hot, which allows him to have amazing side-by-side abilities.  Using the right side of his body, Shoto is able to dramatically reduce temperature and freeze anything he touches, while also creating ice that he can freely mold into various structures including waves of ice.  Covers large areas and ice fences.


 High Endurance: Shoto has proven himself to be quite resilient, being able to withstand many attacks from Izuku, including a direct punch, One For All - enhanced with 5% strength to the stomach.  , without serious injury.  During his battle with Leviathan, Shoto was able to withstand his punch, powerful enough to destroy the floor of the Humanise headquarters.  One of the most impressive examples of Shoto's resilience is when he withstood Dabi's superior fire control, although, Shoto was partially shielded by his fire control abilities of his own, and Dabi deliberately stifled his final attack leaving Shoto alive.

Enhanced Stamina: Shoto has been shown to be able to endure combat even when injured.  For example, during his battle with Stain, he was able to continue fighting and supporting his teammates despite multiple bleeding wounds on his hands and face, and was still able to drag his opponent's unconscious body.  evil after the battle is over.  When he engaged Dabi in a firework brawl, Shoto continued to fight even though his body was charred.

 Sharp intellect: Shoto has proven to be a very intelligent person.  And despite his training, Shoto also excelled in his studies, finishing 5th in the midterm exam.

Indomitable Will: Shoto has a strong spirit of courage, does not give in easily to his distracting threats, keeps a cool head and overcomes adversity

 Half Cold Half Hot (半はん冷れい半はん燃ねん, Hanrei Hannen): Shoto's Quirk grants him the ability to create ice from the right side of his body and fire from the left.

Due to years of rejecting his father, Shoto has developed a habit of preferring ice, even if fire would be a better choice.  This grudge also makes it difficult for him to control his flames.  Although he has the ability to use both elements at the same time, he is not used to this and still needs to practice two-handed.  While training for his ultimate, he stated that using both abilities at the same time would slow him down.

 Small things:
 +"Todoroki" is a relatively common Japanese surname.
 +His favorite food is Zaru (cold) Soba.
 + Shoto is student number 15 in Class 1-A.
 +Shoto ranked 5th in Class 1-A's midterm score.  
 +Shoto ranked 2nd in Shota's Cognitive Ability Test.
 +Shoto was the runner-up of the First Stage of the UA Games.
 +Since Shoto's eyes and hair show physical separation when his Quirk halves split, he may have a genetic anomaly known as chimera
